title: Quantum simulation of the Haldane phase using open shell molecules
summary: Dipolar molecules in optical traps are a versatile platform for studying many-body phases of quantum matter in the presence of strong and long-range interactions. The dipolar interactions in such setups can be enabled by microwave driving opposite parity rotational levels of the molecules.
